title: Opt-in app shell opens the admitted live VM through Firebase owner authentication
requires: Vite on 5174 with VITE_VM_WORKSPACES_ENABLED=true and explicit public Firebase API key/project configuration from src/services/auth.js; CDP Chrome on 9222 or isolated fallback on 9223; vm-owner-api-proof.mjs shell supplies the fixed synthetic owner's custom token in memory

steps.assert: Sign in using the fixed fixture custom token; actual shell lists and selects vm-proof-605
Owner discovery, canonical-session reads and signed access requests succeed
Shell shows running workspace power, a connected Agent iframe on the admitted VM gateway, and live CPU/RAM meter samples
No VM-scoped legacy API calls; mixed-mode startup may retain a listener for another legacy workspace, while the selected VM uses vmApi_v2 session polling; no unexpected console/network failures

limits: No model credentials/chat, machine mutation, migration or configuration acceptance. The synthetic upstream Device Center may return the verified NOT_PAIRED 409.
